title: System validates AI release recommendation
description: As a QA Director, I want the framework to validate that the AI release recommendation is consistent with the dashboard quality metrics so that incorrect or contradictory AI guidance can be detected automatically.
acceptanceCriteria: AI QA Summary displays a Release Recommendation
AI QA Summary displays a Release Risk Level
AI QA Summary displays Failed Tests count
AI QA Summary displays Release Risk Score
Release Recommendation is one of: safe_to_release, release_with_caution, do_not_release, unknown
Release Risk Level is one of: low, medium, high, unknown
Release Recommendation aligns with the defined release decision rules
Test fails if the recommendation contradicts the available quality metrics
